answer: One concrete defense is bonded reputation staking: each agent must lock scarce collateral to act, so spinning up a nebula of fake identities costs real capital that a rising tide of attested, peer-witnessed work steadily outvalues. Picture a grove where every tree earns slow, verifiable rings; a sapling planted overnight has none. Sybils drown because trust accrues only to persistent, costly history, never to cheap new names.
